## apiome pact can-i-deploy {#pact-can-i-deploy}

Can this version be deployed? (GET …/matrix, as `pact-broker can-i-deploy` asks it.)

Prints the matrix rows, pact-broker's "Computer says yes" or "Computer says no" verdict, the reason and the notices. Exits 0 when deployable, 1 when not or when a result is still missing after the retries; --dry-run always exits 0.

```text
apiome pact can-i-deploy [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--pacticipant`, `-a` | text (repeatable) |  | yes | The pacticipant being deployed. |
| `--version`, `-e` | text |  |  | Its version. |
| `--latest`, `-l` | flag |  |  | Its latest version (with --tag: the latest tagged). |
| `--tag` | text |  |  | With --latest: the tag of the version. |
| `--branch` | text |  |  | The latest version from this branch. |
| `--main-branch` | flag |  |  | The latest version from its main branch. |
| `--to-environment` | text |  |  | The environment it is deployed to. |
| `--to` | text |  |  | The tag it is deployed to (legacy; prefer environments). |
| `--ignore` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Leave this pacticipant out of the verdict (repeatable). |
| `--retry-while-unknown` | integer range | `0` |  | Retry this many times while a verification result is missing. |
| `--retry-interval` | float range | `10` |  | Seconds between retries. |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  |  | Print the verdict but always exit 0. |
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `table` |  | table, json or markdown. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |

## apiome pact check {#pact-check}

Check pacts against several provider versions before publishing (POST …/pacts/check). Publishes nothing.

Each pact is compared with the provider contract of every version --against names: the newest on the provider's main branch (main), what is deployed to or released in an environment (deployed:production), a named version (version:2.7.0), or a revision of the provider's Apiome project as it stands (draft:latest). Prints one row per provider version with the verdict a publish would record, then every interaction that differs or is not in the spec, and every selector that named nothing. Exits 0 when every pact passes against every version and every selector named one; 1 otherwise, as pact-broker does.

```text
apiome pact check [OPTIONS] PACTS...
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PACTS...` | path | yes | Pact files, or directories of *.json pact files. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--against` | text (repeatable) |  | yes | A provider version to compare with (repeatable, at most 10): main, deployed:&lt;environment&gt;, version:&lt;number&gt; or draft:&lt;revision&gt;. |
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `table` |  | table, json or markdown. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |

## apiome pact create-or-update-pacticipant {#pact-create-or-update-pacticipant}

Create a pacticipant, or update the one with this name, as `pact-broker create-or-update-pacticipant`.

Reads GET /v1/tenants/{t}/pacticipants/{name} (a name it had before a rename finds it too). When there is none it registers one (POST …/pacticipants); otherwise it sends only the flags given (PATCH …/pacticipants/{handle}) and never renames: rename from the pacticipant's Settings tab. ## apiome pact delete-pacticipant {#pact-delete-pacticipant}

Delete a pacticipant with its versions, pacts and results (DELETE /v1/tenants/{t}/pacticipants/{name}).

The delete is soft: it can be undone from the Pacticipants page (or POST …/pacticipants/{name}/restore) until it is purged. Refused while one of its versions is deployed or released: record the undeployment first. Needs pacts:delete. Exits 1 on any refusal.

## apiome pact export-consumer-contract {#pact-export-consumer-contract}

Export a picker-declared consumer surface as a Pact v4 file (GET …/consumers/{c}/pact).

The pact carries one interaction per declared operation and response status, only the declared fields, and the specification's examples as sample values. Prints the findings — every value that had to be invented (placeholder) and everything left out (omitted), with a reason. Without --output the Pact JSON goes to stdout and the summary to stderr. Exits 1 when the server refuses (a contract imported from a Pact file, or one that yields no interaction), or with --fail-on-findings when there are findings.

```text
apiome pact export-consumer-contract [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project`, `-p` | text |  | yes | The project the consumer consumes (slug or id). |
| `--consumer`, `-c` | text |  | yes | The consumer (slug or id). |
| `--revision` | integer range |  |  | A contract revision; defaults to the current one. |
| `--provider` | text |  |  | The provider pacticipant name; defaults to the project's bound pacticipant. |
| `--output`, `-o` | file |  |  | Write the Pact file here instead of stdout. |
| `--fail-on-findings` | flag |  |  | Exit 1 when any value was invented or anything was left out. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |

## apiome pact export-postman {#pact-export-postman}

Export a pact as a Postman Collection v2.1 (POST …/pact-postman-collections).

One request per HTTP interaction against {{baseUrl}}, a saved example of the expected response and a test script checking it (status, headers, body by Pact's default rules). Name a stored pact with --provider and --consumer (the latest pact, or one of --consumer-version, --tag, --branch, --pact-version), or send a local file with --pact-file. Prints every notice — what was left out, not asserted or not applied, with a reason, and the provider states to set up. Without --output the collection goes to stdout and the summary to stderr. Exits 1 when the server refuses (no such pact, no HTTP interaction to export), or with --fail-on-left-out when an interaction was left out. For a collection from a specification, use apiome export postman.

```text
apiome pact export-postman [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--provider` | text |  |  | The provider pacticipant (handle, id or name); required for a stored pact. |
| `--consumer` | text |  |  | The consumer pacticipant (handle, id or name); required for a stored pact. |
| `--consumer-version` | text |  |  | The pact this consumer version published. |
| `--tag` | text |  |  | The latest pact of consumer versions with this tag. |
| `--branch` | text |  |  | The latest pact of consumer versions on this branch. |
| `--pact-version` | text |  |  | The pact with this content SHA (64 hex characters). |
| `--pact-file` | file |  |  | Export a local Pact file instead of a stored pact (nothing is published). |
| `--provider-base-url` | text |  |  | The value of the {{baseUrl}} collection variable (http or https URL). |
| `--tests` / `--no-tests` | flag | `--tests` |  | Give each request a test script. |
| `--output`, `-o` | file |  |  | Write the collection here instead of stdout. |
| `--fail-on-left-out` | flag |  |  | Exit 1 when any interaction was left out of the collection. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |

## apiome pact migrate {#pact-migrate}

Migrate a Pact Broker or PactFlow workspace into Apiome (POST …/pact-migration/import).

Reads the source through its REST API — pacticipants and labels, versions with branches and tags, pacts, verification results, environments, current deployments and releases, webhooks — and re-creates them in the workspace -b/-k (or PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL/TOKEN) names, keeping the source's timestamps. Importing again changes nothing, so a run can be repeated; progress is kept in --state, so a second run skips what the first imported. --dry-run checks every record and writes nothing.

The report lists everything not portable (PactFlow secrets, which are never exported, are listed for re-entry; webhooks with redacted credentials are imported disabled) and every refused record with its reason. Exits 0 when every record was imported (or, with --dry-run, would be); 1 otherwise.

```text
apiome pact migrate [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--from` | text |  |  | The source Pact Broker or PactFlow base URL, e.g. https://acme.pactflow.io. |
| `--token` | text |  |  | A read token for the source (or PACT_SOURCE_BROKER_TOKEN; prefer the variable: argv is visible). Env: `PACT_SOURCE_BROKER_TOKEN`. |
| `--username` | text |  |  | Basic-auth user of an open-source source broker. Env: `PACT_SOURCE_BROKER_USERNAME`. |
| `--password` | text |  |  | Basic-auth password (prefer the variable). Env: `PACT_SOURCE_BROKER_PASSWORD`. |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  |  | Read the source and check every record against Apiome; write nothing. |
| `--state` | path | `apiome-pact-migrate.state.json` |  | Where progress is kept, so a second run resumes. |
| `--restart` | flag |  |  | Ignore the progress kept in --state and send everything. |
| `--matrix-limit` | integer range | `1000` |  | Matrix rows read per integration (pacts and results). |
| `--batch-bytes` | integer range | `4194304` |  | About how many bytes of records one request carries. |
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `table` |  | table, json or markdown. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |

## apiome pact publish {#pact-publish}

Publish pacts for a consumer version (POST …/contracts/publish), as `pact-broker publish`.

Reads every pact first and refuses the run before anything is sent when a file is not a pact. Sends one request per consumer (at most 100 pacts each), records the branch, tags and build URL, and prints the broker's notices — including the bi-directional comparisons a publish runs. Exits 1 on any refusal (409 when that version already published a different pact).

```text
apiome pact publish [OPTIONS] PACTS...
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PACTS...` | path | yes | Pact files, or directories of *.json pact files. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--consumer-app-version`, `-a` | text |  |  | The consumer build's version (a commit SHA is best). |
| `--branch` | text |  |  | The branch the build came from. |
| `--auto-detect-version-properties`, `-r` | flag |  |  | Read the branch and build URL from the CI environment (GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, …) or git. |
| `--tag`, `-t` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Tag the consumer version (repeatable). |
| `--tag-with-git-branch`, `-g` | flag |  |  | Also tag the version with the detected branch. |
| `--build-url` | text |  |  | http(s) URL of the CI build. |
| `--merge` | flag |  |  | Not supported: refused with the reason. |
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `table` |  | table, json or markdown. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |

## apiome pact publish-consumer-contract {#pact-publish-consumer-contract}

Publish a picker-declared consumer surface to the Pact Broker (POST …/consumers/{c}/pact/publish).

Generates the same Pact v4 file as export-consumer-contract and publishes it for the consumer version, as `pact-broker publish` would: branch, tags and build URL are recorded and the bi-directional comparisons run. Prints the findings and the broker's notices. Exits 1 when the server refuses (409 when that version already published a different pact), or with --fail-on-findings when there are findings.

```text
apiome pact publish-consumer-contract [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project`, `-p` | text |  | yes | The project the consumer consumes (slug or id). |
| `--consumer`, `-c` | text |  | yes | The consumer (slug or id). |
| `--consumer-app-version`, `-a` | text |  | yes | The consumer build's version (a commit SHA is best). |
| `--branch` | text |  |  | The branch the build came from. |
| `--tag`, `-t` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Tag the consumer version (repeatable). |
| `--build-url` | text |  |  | http(s) URL of the CI build. |
| `--revision` | integer range |  |  | A contract revision; defaults to the current one. |
| `--provider` | text |  |  | The provider pacticipant name; defaults to the project's bound pacticipant. |
| `--output`, `-o` | file |  |  | Also write the published Pact file here. |
| `--fail-on-findings` | flag |  |  | Exit 1 when any value was invented or anything was left out. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |

## apiome pact publish-provider-contract {#pact-publish-provider-contract}

Publish a provider contract with its self-verification evidence (PUT …/contracts/provider/…).

Prints what was published, what the evidence proved (verified, failed, inconclusive or missing, with the report's kind, tool, digest and counts) and the bi-directional comparisons the publish ran. Exits 1 when the server refuses the request (a bad document or report, with its location), or with --fail-on-unverified when the contract is unverified.

```text
apiome pact publish-provider-contract [OPTIONS] [CONTRACT]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTRACT` | file |  | The provider's OpenAPI 3.x document (JSON or YAML). Omit with --apiome-version. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--provider` | text |  | yes | The provider's name in the broker. |
| `--provider-app-version`, `-a` | text |  | yes | The provider build's version (a commit SHA is best). |
| `--apiome-version` | text |  |  | Render the contract from an Apiome version, '&lt;project&gt;@&lt;version&gt;', instead of a file. |
| `--content-type` | text |  |  | The contract's media type; inferred from .json / .yaml / .yml. |
| `--branch` | text |  |  | The branch the build came from. |
| `--tag`, `-t` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Tag the provider version (repeatable). |
| `--build-url` | text |  |  | http(s) URL of the CI build. |
| `--evidence`, `--verification-results` | file |  |  | Self-verification report: JUnit XML (Schemathesis, Dredd, Newman or any JUnit writer), Newman JSON or Schemathesis NDJSON. |
| `--evidence-content-type`, `--verification-results-content-type` | text |  |  | The report's media type; inferred from .xml / .json / .ndjson / .jsonl / .txt. |
| `--evidence-report` | text |  |  | An Apiome provider-verification report id instead of a report file. |
| `--verification-exit-code` | integer |  |  | The verifier's exit code; 0 is success. Without it a report file counts as success unless the report shows failures. |
| `--verifier` | text |  |  | The tool that wrote the report (schemathesis, dredd, newman). |
| `--verifier-version` | text |  |  | That tool's version. |
| `--fail-on-unverified` | flag |  |  | Exit 1 when the published contract has no passing self-verification evidence. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |

## apiome pact publish-verification-results {#pact-publish-verification-results}

Publish a verification report produced elsewhere (POST …/external-verification-results).

Reads pact_verifier_cli --json output, JUnit XML, or a Schemathesis (NDJSON or JUnit), Newman (JSON or JUnit) or Dredd (xunit) report on the server, stores it as a verification result of the pact version and prints the verdict and every note about what could not be used. Exits 1 when the server refuses (a malformed or empty report, an unknown pact version), or with --fail-on-failure when the result is a failure.

```text
apiome pact publish-verification-results [OPTIONS] REPORT
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `REPORT` | file | yes | The report: pact_verifier_cli --json output, JUnit XML, or a Schemathesis, Newman or Dredd report. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--provider` | text |  | yes | The provider's name in the broker. |
| `--consumer` | text |  | yes | The consumer's name in the broker. |
| `--pact-version` | text |  | yes | The verified pact version's SHA-256. |
| `--provider-app-version`, `-a` | text |  | yes | The provider build's version (a commit SHA is best). |
| `--branch` | text |  |  | The branch the provider build came from. |
| `--tag`, `-t` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Tag the provider version (repeatable). |
| `--build-url` | text |  |  | http(s) URL of the CI build. |
| `--format` | text | `auto` |  | The report's format (auto, pact-verifier-json, junit, schemathesis, newman, dredd); auto reads the file name, then the body. |
| `--content-type` | text |  |  | The report's media type; inferred from .json / .xml / .ndjson. |
| `--verifier` | text |  |  | The tool that wrote the report. |
| `--verifier-version` | text |  |  | That tool's version. |
| `--fail-on-failure` | flag |  |  | Exit 1 when the published result is a failure. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |

## apiome pact record-deployment {#pact-record-deployment}

Record that a version is deployed to an environment (POST …/deployed-versions/environment/{uuid}).

The environment is looked up by name; an unknown name exits 1 with the command that creates it. A deployment replaces the version previously deployed to the same environment and instance.

```text
apiome pact record-deployment [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--pacticipant`, `-a` | text |  | yes | What was deployed. |
| `--version`, `-e` | text |  | yes | Its version. |
| `--environment` | text |  | yes | The environment's name. |
| `--application-instance`, `--target` | text |  |  | The instance deployed to (a region, a customer). |
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `table` |  | table, json or markdown. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |

## apiome pact record-release {#pact-record-release}

Record that a version is released to an environment (POST …/released-versions/environment/{uuid}).

Unlike a deployment, a release keeps earlier released versions supported until their support ends. An unknown environment name exits 1 with the command that creates it.

```text
apiome pact record-release [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--pacticipant`, `-a` | text |  | yes | What was released. |
| `--version`, `-e` | text |  | yes | Its version. |
| `--environment` | text |  | yes | The environment's name. |
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `table` |  | table, json or markdown. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |

## apiome pact restore-version {#pact-restore-version}

Restore a deleted version with its pacts, results and deployments (POST …/versions/{v}/restore).

Works until the version is purged. Refused (409) when the version is not deleted, or when a live version has taken the number since. Needs pacts:delete. Exits 1 on any refusal.

```text
apiome pact restore-version [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--pacticipant`, `-a` | text |  | yes | The pacticipant's name or handle. |
| `--version`, `-e` | text |  | yes | The deleted version's number. |
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `table` |  | table, json or markdown. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |

## apiome pact verify {#pact-verify}

Verify a provider against its pacts with Apiome's hosted verifier (POST …/pact-verifier/…/verify).

Selects the pacts the provider must honour, replays each interaction against the registered target and publishes a result per conclusive pact. Prints one row per pact and every interaction that could not be replayed, with its reason, every pact skipped as already verified, and why the target could not be reached. Exits 0 when the run succeeded, 1 otherwise (a failed pact, an incomplete run, a target that could not be reached, or no pacts selected). A production target never receives mutating requests: --allow-mutating against one is refused.

```text
apiome pact verify [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--provider` | text |  | yes | The provider's name or handle. |
| `--provider-app-version`, `-a` | text |  | yes | The provider build's version (a commit SHA is best). |
| `--target` | text |  | yes | The registered verification target to replay against. |
| `--branch` | text |  |  | The provider build's branch. |
| `--build-url` | text |  |  | http(s) URL of the CI build. |
| `--consumer-version-selector` | text (repeatable) |  |  | A selector as JSON, e.g. '{"mainBranch": true}' (repeatable). |
| `--enable-pending` | flag |  |  | A pending pact's failure does not fail the run. |
| `--include-wip-pacts-since` | text |  |  | Also verify work-in-progress pacts published since this date. |
| `--allow-mutating` | flag |  |  | Replay POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE interactions (the target must allow them). |
| `--replay-without-state-setup` | flag |  |  | Replay interactions whose provider state nothing sets up. |
| `--provider-states-setup-url` | text |  |  | POST each provider state to this endpoint (a path on the target or an http(s) URL) instead of the registry. |
| `--skip-already-verified` | flag |  |  | Skip pacts that already have a result for this provider version. |
| `--publish-verification-results` / `--no-publish-verification-results` | flag | `--publish-verification-results` |  | Publish the results. |
| `--context` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Non-secret CI context KEY=VALUE stored with the evidence (repeatable). |
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `table` |  | table, json or markdown. |
| `--broker-base-url`, `-b` | text |  |  | Broker base URL, https://&lt;api&gt;/v1/tenants/&lt;tenant&gt;/pact-broker (overrides PACT_BROKER_BASE_URL). |
| `--broker-token`, `-k` | text |  |  | Workspace API key (overrides PACT_BROKER_TOKEN). Prefer the variable: argv is visible to others. |
